cases.claim_description: Synthetic turbocharger vibration and shutdown on MT ALDER; reported mechanical damage requires independent verification.

source_lines: Synthetic MT ALDER casualty notice
Turbocharger vibration was reported on 2026-09-03.
Causation, policy coverage and responsibility have not been established.
Synthetic MT ALDER Chief Engineer account
Alarm reported at 14:20 UTC, load reduction at 14:24 UTC, shutdown at 14:31 UTC.
The account is not independently verified.
Synthetic MT ALDER engine log extract
At 14:20 UTC an alarm was recorded; at 14:31 UTC shutdown was recorded.
This supplied extract is not proof of an original complete log.
Synthetic MT ALDER maintenance record
Inspection entered on 2026-08-12; maintenance pages were supplied.
Completeness and authenticity of this extract are unverified.

cases.claim_description: Synthetic MT CEDAR has conflicting alarm-time observations from different persons.

source_lines: Synthetic MT CEDAR notification
Turbocharger event reportedly occurred 2026-09-07.
The notification does not resolve the machinery timeline.
Synthetic MT CEDAR engineer account
First alarm occurred at 11:30 UTC, according to the engineer.
Original logger timestamps are unavailable for independent verification.
Synthetic MT CEDAR workshop account
First alarm occurred at 11:55 UTC, according to the workshop.
Its source clock and original log have not been verified.
Synthetic MT CEDAR survey record status
Two attributed alarm times conflict.
No independent reconciliation was supplied.

cases.claim_description: Synthetic MT DUNE corrected a prior shutdown-time report; preserve superseded and current document versions.

source_lines: Synthetic MT DUNE claim notice
A high-temperature alarm was reported 2026-09-09.
Investigation remains preliminary.
Synthetic MT DUNE engineer report first issue
Shutdown is recorded at 13:15 UTC.
This is the first issue; original logger not yet reconciled.
Synthetic MT DUNE recorder extract
Alarm at 13:04 UTC; shutdown at 13:51 UTC.
The supplied recorder extract has not been independently authenticated.
Synthetic MT DUNE workshop note
Scoring to turbocharger housing observed.
Root cause and coverage are not determined.
Synthetic MT DUNE engineer report corrected issue
The previous 13:15 UTC shutdown notation was a transposition error.
Corrected reported shutdown: 13:51 UTC; recorder authenticity remains unverified.
